Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelCompiledEvaluationPlan

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelCompiledEvaluationPlan
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ProcessModelCompiledEvaluationPlan extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable fail-closed plan for repeated transactional ProcessModel evaluations.

Compilation qualifies the current converged baseline through the supplied ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator, then freezes area order and structure versions, action and hydraulic-binding definitions, evaluator configuration, and exact installed-capacity and process-boundary coverage. The qualified model and area object identities are also frozen: equal names and structure counters do not authorize replacement instances. Candidate evaluation is refused before mutation when any frozen definition has changed. A delegated candidate is accepted only when the full model converged, every action was restored, the restored baseline reconverged, and the exact expected evidence remains finite and complete.

The plan deliberately does not schedule candidates concurrently because all candidates share mutable equipment. Use independently cloned models and independently compiled plans for parallel optimization. The class adds no equipment physics and does not infer missing capacity ratings.

1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team

  • Method Details

    • compile

      public static ProcessModelCompiledEvaluationPlan compile(String id, String name, String provenance, String sourceBaseline, ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator evaluator)
      Compiles and qualifies a transactional evaluation plan at the current baseline.

      The current action values are evaluated as a no-change candidate. Compilation fails unless that candidate is fully feasible, all actions restore, the baseline reconverges, and at least one installed-capacity constraint is present.

      Parameters:
      id - stable plan identifier
      name - human-readable plan name
      provenance - engineering source for the selected actions and required evidence
      sourceBaseline - exact source or configuration baseline identifier
      evaluator - configured transactional evaluator
      Returns:
      immutable compiled plan

    • evaluate

      Evaluates one candidate against the frozen plan and complete transactional replay.
      Parameters:
      candidateValues - values in action declaration order and declared units
      Returns:
      immutable fail-closed result
